bio.text: Sean Vadney is the Libertarian Party candidate for Colorado Secretary of State in the 2026 general election.
According to the campaign website, Vadney was born in a Denver suburb, was raised by a single mother, and has been involved in national, state and local politics for almost seven years.
The site says Vadney is a small business owner.
